title: Analytic: leaky Fabry-Perot slab resonance and Q (FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
A dielectric slab (thickness L = 600 nm) in vacuum, y-periodic strip with CPML along x, solved by the eigenfrequency study (em_fdfd_ez) near its 4th-order resonance. The sweep runs the facet reflectance R_mirror over 0.2-0.5 by setting n_slab = (1 + sqrt(R)) / (1 - sqrt(R)); the target wavelength follows lambda_res.
Analytic (open slab, exp(+j omega t)): omega_m = (c / (n L)) (m pi + j ln((n + 1)/(n - 1))), so lambda_m = 2 n L / m (= 300 n nm for m = 4: the wavelength inside the slab is always 2 L / m = 300 nm) and Q_m = Re omega / (2 Im omega) = pi m / (-ln R), R = ((n - 1)/(n + 1))^2.
Sweep tab: derived lambda_1 and Q_1 (resonance nearest the target, row 0 of em.resonances) vs R_mirror with the dashed exact references; the extra dashed curve Q_finesse = pi m sqrt(R) / (1 - R) on Q_1 is the high-reflectance (finesse) approximation, which the exact Q leaves at low R. pml_1 = the resonance's share of |E_z|^2 in the PML (keep it well below 0.5).
Field tab: the Snapshot slider shows each resonance (field 1 at its peak; the leaky tail grows toward the PML).
Expected agreement: lambda_1 ~5e-4 (discrete dispersion, 60 cells per slab wavelength), Q_1 ~0.5 % (discrete facet reflection, PML).
